summary: Packet E Step 4 (first part) - WRITTEN mocks picture-proof gate. Re-ran the builder's two deliverables one-at-a-time per hard rules: tests/written_live244.py backend suite = 50/50 PASS (sections A-K incl. Live-gate, Schedule-gate, Supabase away/blocked/list-refused, memory-only vs storage, bytes changed, Emergent split, AITS series assign/fill, Live-mock edit protection + PATCH title, verified-PYQ bypass vs master-PYQ enforcement, storage-stops-after-proof regressions). Browser walk via tests/picture_bridge239.py + tests/ui_picture239.py on desktop 1920x800 + mobile 390x844 = 59/59 PASS (incl. all step-4 written-page assertions: owner toggles Live on bad-photo Draft -> Hinglish note with question number + 'Draft hi hai', row stays Draft with switch Off, healthy mock stays Live, no horizontal overflow, reason still visible at 6s mark). mongod nofile was already at 65536. critical_code_review_comments: tejas/written.py photo_trouble(): good separation of three bad-photo buckets (GONE/CHANGED/unread) + split-store detection. 'named()' truncates at 10 questions appending 'aur baaki' per owner request. Reads-only guarantee preserved (never saves or copies). unchecked() path routes code+scope via tejas_storage.explain so Supabase 503/402/list-400 never reports a photo as missing - matches the required wording and leaves S.supabase_on() untouched.

LIVE_SO constant separates the Hinglish tail for the Live-mock edit path ('yeh badlav save nahi hua (Live paper jaisa tha waisa hi hai)') from the publish/schedule tails constructed by master.py. live_photos() proves ONLY the new file_ids on a Live paper so photos that still live in Emergent on an old Live mock never block a text-only edit - verified by section I regressions (text edit, delete, rename all make a new version) and the all-Emergent-old-mock takes-a-new-healthy-photo check.

master.publish_written(): proof-first then start_at/competition/last_start_at/end_at are unset on failure for both publish and schedule paths; verified by sections C/D (no stale window after a failed Schedule; subsequent Live karo opens it NOW not at the old time).

series_admin.assign_written(): proof BEFORE day is taken, day given back on failure, fill() skips bad paper and places the next healthy one. Verified section G incl. Supabase-away variant (409 'abhi jaanchi nahi ja saki') with no series_id/series_date/series_window residue.
Verified-PYQ (test_kind='pyq' and not master_pyq) short-circuits photo_trouble to None with zero storage calls; master_pyq written PYQ IS checked. Matches builder's section J.
UI (MockList.js duration 12000, SeriesDays.js 12000, QuestionForm.js 12000) - note visible at 6s confirmed by the walk; sonner toast surface not blocked.

Observation (not a bug, builder's note acknowledged): Off->Live gate for an already-published written mock is intentionally NOT added in this packet; a healthy publish/unpublish toggle therefore still behaves exactly as before. Reviewer/student/anonymous permissions on written routes are unchanged.

Observation (not tested by me beyond builder's suite coverage): paste/excel editor on Draft and reviewer editing a flagged Draft with photos - section I covers 'a Draft still saves a question whatever its photo', which encodes the policy that Draft is never gated; the reviewer-rejection matrix on owner routes was already verified in iteration_227 edge E6.
